name: Three attempted or rapidly terminated sensitive federal-contractor placements

attribution.legal_posture: Official federal indictment; two attempts were stopped before completion and one placement was rapidly terminated. Agency compromise status lies outside the reported events.

caveats: Behavioral signals require corroboration and human review; staffing, badge, device, download, location, and sector signals become DPRK attribution only with supporting evidence.
The official federal indictment records two attempts stopped before completion and one placement rapidly terminated; the source asserts no agency compromise.
official indictment; allegation only; the filing expressly says the attempts were discovered and thwarted or terminated

statements: The indictment describes three distinct sensitive federal-contractor attempts: one candidate did not complete required fingerprint verification, one withdrew after background-check and fingerprint instructions, and one briefly attended meetings before rapid termination. These are attempted or limited placements, not evidence that the affected agencies were compromised.
defensive_controls: Retain mandatory fingerprints or equivalent in-person/high-assurance proofing for sensitive contractor access.
Treat withdrawal immediately after a biometric/background-check requirement as a risk signal, not proof of guilt.
Revalidate verbal and technical identity continuity during early meetings; rapidly suspend access when the onboarded person cannot consistently participate.
Document this as attempted/limited placement, not compromise of ICE, FPS or GSA.
